artists.biography: Todd Harry Rundgren (born June 22, 1948) is an American multi-instrumentalist, songwriter and record producer. Hailed in the early stage of his career as a new pop star, supported by the certified gold solo double LP Something/Anything? in 1972, his career has produced a diverse range of recordings as solo artist, and during the seventies and eighties with the band Utopia. He has also been prolific as a producer and engineer on the recorded work of other musicians.

perplexity.description:
Hermit of Mink Hollow," released in April 1978 on Bearsville Records, is the eighth studio album by American musician Todd Rundgren. The album showcases Rundgren's multi-instrumental talents, as he performed all instruments and vocals himself. Musically, it blends rock and pop with a focus on melodic songwriting and accessible arrangements, marking a shift from his previous more progressive and experimental work with his band Utopia.

This album is often regarded as a "return to form" for Rundgren, emphasizing concise, well-crafted songs over the complex prog-rock styles he had explored earlier in the 1970s. It occupies a significant place in his discography as a solo effort that reestablished his reputation as a pop-rock auteur. Critically, "Hermit of Mink Hollow" was well received for its strong songwriting and production, and it performed respectably on the charts, reinforcing Rundgren’s status as a versatile and influential figure in rock music.
